name: raysan5/raylib
description: A simple and easy-to-use C library for videogames programming, with no external dependencies and support for Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, and WebAssembly. Widely adopted for education, prototyping, and indie game development.
score_rationale: Industry-standard beginner-to-intermediate game library with 31k+ stars, extremely active maintenance, and ubiquitous community adoption.
summary: Simple, dependency-free 2D game library for education and indie games
